title: How I Break Down Any Competitor's Video With Claude
description:
Comment "SKILLS" and I'll send you the link.

Claude gave me a competitor's video broken down cut by cut, with the on-screen text and the timing of every edit. Here's the catch: Claude cannot watch video. It has no video model at all.

So most tools that claim to analyze video are really just reading the transcript. That means they miss the cuts, the overlays, the b-roll, and the hook, which is half of what makes a video work.

This skill does something simple. It rips the video into frames, transcribes the audio, and hands both to Claude. The smart part is how it samples: the first 15 seconds get 15 frames per second, because that's where retention is won or lost, and the rest gets one frame every 3 seconds.

It runs entirely on your machine. And if your video already has captions, it costs basically nothing.

Subscribe. I build one of these every week.
